stem:
The shaded part of the model represents a fraction. Another fraction was subtracted from the first fraction.

Which expression does the model represent?
visual_elements: A rectangular model divided into 3 rows and 5 columns (15 small rectangles total). The first 11 small rectangles are shaded gray. Another portion of these shaded rectangles are marked by an X shape covering 4 of those shaded small rectangles.
notes: The model shows subtraction of a fraction from a fraction with denominators related to 15. The options and fractions exactly match the fractions visualized.
